note: The Critical pull_request_target path from the test workflow was judged false: it runs only on `types: [labeled]` when a maintainer applies `safe to test`, and the checkout of `head.sha || github.sha` is the labelled head commit under pull_request_target, so the path holds as a maintainer-approved Medium at most.

paths.pending: a checkout of the pull request head SHA written with a fallback (`head.sha || github.sha`, `head.sha || github.ref`, `event_name == 'pull_request_target' && head.sha || github.ref`) is not read as a pinned head commit, although under pull_request_target it is always the head SHA, so the maintainer-approved path holds at High instead of Medium.
